payload.core_mechanism_summary: Exhaustive O(n^2) check of all pairs of semicircles for intersection using nested loops.
payload.rationale: The solution checks every possible pair of semicircles (edges) for intersection. This is a complete search. Among the given complete_search subtypes, 'search_dfs_bfs_graph' is the highest-scoring option despite not using graph traversal; it was chosen as the least unfitting match.
